response.rationale: These look like two different concepts. Each has its own repository. Club Booking is stored in ClubBookingRepository (node 440da90bcde7901a, src/persistence/clubBookingRepository.ts) as `private readonly bookings = new Map<string, ClubBooking>();`. ClubService calls it for book, getRate, setRate and invoice, and RinkService calls it for effectiveCapacity. That points to a club reserving rink capacity under negotiated rates and being invoiced for it. Booking is read by ReportService (node a663bd12cbc0090c, src/business/reportService.ts) through BookingRepository.listBySession, and it carries a payment status (`} else if (b.status === "paid") {`). That points to an individual booking for a session. Both are reservations, but they come from different parties, have different lifecycles (club rates and invoices versus a per-session paid status) and live in different stores. I can't see the full class definitions, so the confidence is moderate.
